name: g_gfxCmdListBaseVtable
comment: Base class vtable for the graphics command list singleton (installed in the 52-byte object at 0x00834040 during inlined construction before derived vtable g_gfxCmdListVtable overwrites it).
evidence: Loaded by Engine_Initialize (literal 0x001022E8) and maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton (0x006F2454) into offset 0 of the 0x34-byte BSS buffer at 0x00834040; slots include destructor stubs 0x00101A9F and overrides 0x005631D8/0x00563010.

name: g_gfxRenderContextVtable
comment: Primary vtable of the graphics render context / display presenter singleton (the 0x1F8-byte object at 0x00834084, referenced by *0x007BE358). Installed at offset 0 during construction in Engine_Initialize and maybe_Gfx_GetRenderContext.
evidence: Loaded by literals in Engine_Initialize (0x00102364), maybe_Gfx_GetRenderContext (0x001053C0), maybe_Ui_Widget_DrawSelfAndChildrenEx (0x0021EBB0), Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteListTransition (0x00577E44), and Ui_MainMenuText_ReleaseResources (0x002BD53C) into offset 0 of the 0x1F8-byte presenter object.

name: g_fsChannelTableVtable
comment: Multi-inheritance vtable for the filesystem channel table / worker manager class (the 0xE3C8-byte object at 0x007F52E4, stored in *0x007BE308). Primary vtable is installed at +0 from 0x0078295C+8 and secondary vtable at +4 from 0x0078295C+0x20 (containing Fs_Worker_DtorThunkA at slot +0x24).
evidence: Loaded by Engine_Initialize (literal 0x001022DC) and Ui_LoadingScreen_Create (0x001B6D68), which pass +8 and +0x20 to the constructor 0x00103594; slot at +0x24 points to Fs_Worker_DtorThunkA (0x0066D920); offset-to-top -4 (0xFFFFFFFC) at +0x18.

name: g_fsCacheEvictMonitorVtable
comment: Vtable of the filesystem cache eviction and task monitor controller (the 20-byte object at 0x00833F54, referenced by *0x007BE338). Installed at offset 0 during construction in Engine_Initialize.
evidence: Loaded by Engine_Initialize (literal 0x0010234C) into offset 0 of the 0x14-byte object at 0x00833F54; in the main loop, field +0xC of this object governs whether Fs_CacheSet_BeginEvict or Fs_CacheSet_EndEvict is called on g_fsCacheSet.

name: g_gfxCmdListVtable
comment: Primary vtable of the graphics command list singleton class (the 52-byte object at 0x00834040, pointed to by *0x007BE350). Installed at offset 0 in Engine_Initialize and maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton.
evidence: Loaded by literals in Engine_Initialize (0x001022EC) and maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton (0x006F2458) into offset 0 of the 0x34-byte BSS buffer at 0x00834040, overwriting base vtable 0x007821E8. Callers include overlay draw routines, Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture, and shadow passes.

name: g_gfxRenderContextSecondaryVtable
comment: Secondary vtable of the graphics render context singleton class (installed at sub-object offset 0x60 within the 0x1F8-byte object at 0x00834084). Installed alongside primary vtable g_gfxRenderContextVtable in Engine_Initialize and maybe_Gfx_GetRenderContext.
evidence: Loaded by literals in Engine_Initialize (0x00102368), maybe_Gfx_GetRenderContext (0x001053CC), maybe_Ui_Widget_DrawSelfAndChildrenEx (0x0021EBBC), Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteListTransition (0x00577E48), and Ui_MainMenuText_ReleaseResources (0x002BD548) into [obj + 0x1FC - 0x19C] (offset 0x60).

name: g_gfxDefaultTextureVtable
comment: Vtable of the graphics default texture / framebuffer texture manager class (the 20-byte object at 0x0083428C, stored in *0x007BE360). Installed at offset 0 during construction in Engine_Initialize.
evidence: Loaded by Engine_Initialize (literal 0x001022E0) into offset 0 of the 0x14-byte object at 0x0083428C, followed immediately by maybe_Gfx_InitDefaultTexture(*0x007BE360, &local_40, &local_58); released on shutdown by maybe_Gfx_ReleaseDefaultTexture.

name: g_engineRuntimeFlags
comment: Four-byte engine runtime status and lifecycle control flags. Byte 0 is the engine termination request flag checked by the main loop to break and begin shutdown; byte 1 requests frame callback reset in maybe_Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks; byte 2 stores display info from maybe_Gfx_QueryDisplayInfo.
evidence: Read as byte 0 in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x001022F0) and Engine_ShutdownAllSubsystems to terminate the main frame loop; written in maybe_Mem_InitAllocatorState (0x00102B80), maybe_Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks (0x00102EAC), and maybe_Os_SetRuntimeFlag (0x0010645C).

name: g_engineEarlyExitFlag
comment: One-byte latch recording whether an engine exit was already requested before subsystem initialization began. If non-zero at boot, Engine_Initialize skips entering the main loop and skips unmounting/teardown.
evidence: Written in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x001022E4) as *0x007AE5AC = *0x007AE49C; tested before entering the main loop and tested before shutdown teardown. Initial retail value 0.

name: g_fsCacheEvictMonitorGuardFlag
comment: Initialization guard byte for the filesystem cache eviction monitor singleton. Initialized in the retail data image to 1 (0xFFFFFF01 word); cleared to 0 upon allocating and constructing the object at 0x00833F54.
evidence: Read and cleared by Engine_Initialize (literal 0x00102380) before initializing the 20-byte buffer at 0x00833F54; retail word at 0x007BE334 is 0xFFFFFF01 (byte 0 is 1).

name: g_fsCacheEvictMonitor
comment: Global pointer to the filesystem cache eviction and task monitor controller singleton. Points to the 20-byte object in BSS at 0x00833F54; field +0xC is checked every frame in Engine_Initialize to trigger cache eviction on g_fsCacheSet.
evidence: Written in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x00102350) with the address of the newly constructed 0x14-byte object at 0x00833F54; field at +0xC read in the main loop to control Fs_CacheSet_BeginEvict/EndEvict.

name: g_gfxCmdListGuardFlag
comment: Initialization guard byte for the graphics command list singleton. Retail image value is 1 (0xFFFFFF01 word); cleared to 0 when the 52-byte buffer at 0x00834040 is constructed and stored into g_gfxCmdList.
evidence: Tested and cleared in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x00102324) and maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton (0x006F2448); guards lazy construction of 0x00834040 into 0x007BE350.

name: g_gfxCmdList
comment: Global pointer to the graphics command list / overlay draw manager singleton. Points to the 52-byte object at 0x00834040; accessed by maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton and used throughout 2D overlay and model draw passes.
evidence: Written in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x0010232C) and maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton (0x006F244C) with the object at 0x00834040; used by maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenQuad, Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture, and char shadow passes.

name: g_gfxDefaultTextureGuardFlag
comment: Initialization guard byte for the graphics default texture / framebuffer texture manager singleton. Retail image word is 0xFFFFFF01 (byte 0 is 1); cleared to 0 when the 20-byte object at 0x0083428C is constructed.
evidence: Tested and cleared in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x0010230C) before constructing the 0x14-byte object at 0x0083428C and storing it into 0x007BE360.

name: g_gfxDefaultTexture
comment: Global pointer to the default texture / framebuffer texture manager singleton. Points to the 20-byte object in BSS at 0x0083428C; initialized by maybe_Gfx_InitDefaultTexture and released on shutdown by maybe_Gfx_ReleaseDefaultTexture.
evidence: Written in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x00102314) with the address of the newly constructed 0x14-byte object at 0x0083428C; passed to maybe_Gfx_InitDefaultTexture and maybe_Gfx_ReleaseDefaultTexture.

name: g_engineFrameCallbackLists
comment: Engine frame callback registry containing 5 callback lists (each with a 4-byte count and 4 eight-byte callback function/argument slots, stride 0x24 bytes, 180 bytes total). Protected by re-entrant mutexes at 0x007C865C/0x007C8668 and dispatched each frame by maybe_Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks.
evidence: Literals in maybe_Mem_InitAllocatorState (0x00102B68), maybe_Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks (0x00102EB0), maybe_Os_GetThreadClass (0x001064D0), and maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateB (0x001F3450); loops over 5 lists (+0x00, +0x24, +0x48, +0x6C, +0x90), calling registered functions with their arguments.

name: g_fsCacheSet
comment: Global filesystem cache set and background task descriptor object (60 bytes in BSS). Manages cache entry queues, eviction state, and task flushing; updated each frame by Fs_CacheSet_Flush and Fs_CacheSet_UpdateEntries in Engine_Initialize.
evidence: Initialized by 0x00677CAC with four intrusive list heads (+0x00, +0x0C, +0x18, +0x30); passed by address in Engine_Initialize (literal 0x00102340) to Fs_Task_Create, Fs_CacheSet_BeginEvict, Fs_CacheSet_Flush, Fs_CacheSet_UpdateEntries, and Fs_CacheSet_ReleaseEntries; referenced in maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_CreateSlot (0x00623B40).

name: g_fsCacheEvictMonitorBuffer
comment: Static memory buffer (20 bytes in BSS) hosting the filesystem cache eviction monitor singleton instance pointed to by g_fsCacheEvictMonitor (0x007BE338). Constructed in Engine_Initialize with vtable g_fsCacheEvictMonitorVtable.
evidence: Literal 0x00102384 in Engine_Initialize; allocated/constructed with size 0x14 and stored into 0x007BE338.

name: g_gfxCmdListBuffer
comment: Static memory buffer (52 bytes in BSS) hosting the graphics command list singleton instance pointed to by g_gfxCmdList (0x007BE350). Constructed in Engine_Initialize and maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton with vtable g_gfxCmdListVtable.
evidence: Literals 0x00102328 in Engine_Initialize and 0x006F2450 in maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton; zeroed out and populated with size 0x34 bytes.

name: g_gfxDefaultTextureBuffer
comment: Static memory buffer (20 bytes in BSS) hosting the default texture / framebuffer texture manager singleton instance pointed to by g_gfxDefaultTexture (0x007BE360). Constructed in Engine_Initialize with vtable g_gfxDefaultTextureVtable.
evidence: Literal 0x00102310 in Engine_Initialize; zeroed out and constructed with size 0x14 bytes, then address stored into 0x007BE360.
